$comment: Every skill in use that this repo does not own. `check` verifies our copies still match the pinned upstream text and whether upstream has moved; `update <name>` pulls the current upstream body in. Run: node scripts/upstream.mjs check

skills.name: occams-razor
skills.note: Catalog cut the skill at 733353c (2026-07-16); the body was last revised at e0bb0d9. We stay on the a31e22d text, so `check` treats remaining on the pin as correct and never suggests an update.

skills.name: second-order-thinking
skills.note: Upstream rewrote it at c2e4a73 (2026-07-16) as a lean agent contract. We tested that rewrite and chose to stay on the a31e22d text, so `hold` keeps `check` from flagging it as outstanding work.

skills.name: smart-web-read
skills.note: Own repository. Ships with the `swr` binary, which is the point of the kit: install.sh compiles the binary with this skill text embedded, then `swr init` deploys it into every agent root with a `version:` stamp.

skills.name: impeccable
skills.note: Third-party (pbakaus), not vendored here: it has its own updater and its own version check cached at ~/.impeccable/update-check.json. The npm package `impeccable` is CLI-only and lags the site payload.
